text:
Alex Chen: FYI — Acme Legal sent back the SIG with several BCP/DR questions. They want explicit RTO/RPO numbers, evidence of backups and cross-region failover, and clarification on SLA differences between Hosted vs Dedicated. Need a consolidated reply to attach to the RFP by EOD PST. Who can own drafting the answers?

Priya Nair: I can draft the SIG responses. Quick questions: do we want to state deterministic RTO/RPO or provide target ranges + caveats? (customers often push for hard numbers) :thinking_face:

Jamal Ortiz: For Hosted API we should give target SLAs/targets + operational caveats. Suggest: RTO target for automated cross-region failover: <15 minutes (dependent on routing and customer region). RPO: best-effort for in-memory caches; persistent customer artifacts (control-plane metadata) are replicated and have hourly snapshot RPO, backups daily with 30d retention by default. Dedicated/Private: customers can choose tighter RPO via optional replication/backup configs.

Elena Ruiz: I'll attach the DR runbook excerpt and last 3 DR test summaries (redacted) — that usually satisfies vendor risk teams. Also add reference to SOC2 / penetration test dates. I have the doc links.

Alex Chen: Good. Can you put that into a short SIG-friendly block we can paste into the questionnaire? Also need a simple bullet list for the customer security team listing artifacts we can share (runbook excerpts, DR test results, SOC2, architecture diagram, support/SLAs).

Priya Nair: Drafted suggested answer below — feel free to edit. This is what we should paste into the SIG/CAIQ BCP/DR section: 

```
- RTO (Recovery Time Objective): Hosted: target <15 minutes for automatic cross-region rerouting to healthy capacity under our smart-routing policies; Dedicated: configurable per-customer SLA, typical target 1-4 hours for single-region hardware failures unless multi-region reserved capacity is configured.
- RPO (Recovery Point Objective): Hosted: best-effort for in-memory caches (seconds-to-minutes); persistent control-plane and customer artifacts are protected via cross-region async replication and daily snapshots (default RPO up to 1 hour); Dedicated/Private: configurable with optional frequent snapshot replication.
- Backups & Retention: Daily encrypted snapshots of customer artifacts retained 30 days by default. Optional extended retention and on-demand export for enterprise customers.
- Failover & Continuity: Automated routing and model variant fallbacks, canary rollouts and automatic rollback policies, and region-aware capacity routing. Customers on Dedicated can opt into reserved multi-region capacity for deterministic failover.
- Uptime & SLA: Hosted API: target 99.9% monthly uptime SLA for paid tiers; Dedicated: enterprise SLA options up to 99.95% / 99.99% depending on contract and reserved capacity.
- Evidence & Artifacts: We can provide DR runbook excerpts, recent DR test summaries, SOC2 report, and architecture/topology diagrams under NDA or customer portal access.
```

Priya Nair: Caveat to include under all answers: actual recovery times depend on traffic patterns, customer configuration (e.g., session affinity, KV cache settings), and any in-flight state that cannot be reconstructed. We should avoid guaranteeing recovery of in-memory state unless customer configures persistent replication.

Jamal Ortiz: Minor edits: change "up to 1 hour" RPO wording to "default RPO up to 1 hour for persistent artifacts; quicker replication available with config" to avoid implying strict guarantees. Also add: we run quarterly DR exercises and keep a changelog of findings.

Elena Ruiz: Adding attachments: runbook_excerpt_v2.pdf (redacted), dr-test-summaries-q3-q4.pdf, soc2-summary-2025.pdf, infra-topology-vpc.png. I'll upload to the secure share and post link.

Alex Chen: Perfect. Timeline — can we finalize and send to Acme by 18:00 PST? I can follow up with Legal for any redactions.

Priya Nair: I'll finalize the SIG text + add Jamal's edits by 16:30 and drop the attachments Elena posts.

Elena Ruiz: Uploading now. Link: https://internal.redwood/share/secure/Acme-DR-evidence (permissioned).

ops-bot: Reminder: attach all customer-facing docs to the vaulted share, mark as "RFP - Acme" and include the document checklist: runbook excerpt, DR test summaries, SOC2 summary, topology diagram.

Alex Chen: Thanks team — I'll send the consolidated packet after Priya confirms. :thumbsup:
